name: Epic Structures: Villages
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: ATi
description: This mod completely replaces and overhauls Minecraft villages with sprawling cities and towns based on medieval architecture.
works: The game's five villages (plains, desert, savanna, snowy, taiga) replaced by bigger towns of medieval architecture (its pieces over the game's).
note: From Modrinth, unchanged; a new world needed (structures generate with new chunks)
